text:
alyssa: Heads-up — iterating on the model catalog compare table. Two patterns to decide: 1) a sticky 'comparison summary' row when 2+ rows are selected (aggregated perf + cost), or 2) compress active filters into a single 'Filters' chip that expands into a flyout. Mock attached. Quick thoughts? seon (Design): I lean toward the summary row. But worried about vertical real estate on narrower screens — could be collapsible and show only primary badges by default. :thinking: mike_s (Eng): Backend/renderer note: sticky row + list virtualization is doable but we need to render the sticky outside the virtual container. I can prototype but it's an extra DOM level. jamie (Product): Copy recs for badges: use short labels to avoid wrapping — e.g. 'Latency (p50)', 'Cost / 1k', 'Fail %'. Keep them 1–2 words. ravi (Eng-ML): Add 'KV cache hit' as a mini metric if applicable — that's often the deciding factor for model selection in prod. luz (A11y): A11y nits: the sticky summary must be keyboard-focusable and announced when it appears. For the filters chip, ensure aria-expanded toggles and the flyout has appropriate role and label. seon (Design): Quick aria example: ```html
...
``` mike_s (Eng): Also for performance badges: use both color + shape/icon so information isn't conveyed by color alone. SVG icon + visually-hidden text for screen readers. jamie (Product): Empty-state copy suggestion for the flyout: 'No filters applied — try "model size" or "latency" to narrow results.' Keeps it actionable. alyssa: Another question — where should 'version lock' live? Toolbar bulk action or per-row context menu? Toolbar is nice for bulk locking. ravi (Eng-ML): Agree both are useful: toolbar for multi-select + per-row action for single locks. Implementation-wise that's straightforward. seon (Design): Updated mock: added a compact toolbar 'Lock version' button + per-row lock icon. Preview attached. :sparkles: luz (A11y): Ensure 'Lock version' triggers a confirm dialog and we announce status via role=status (e.g., 'Version locked for 3 models'). Also ensure the lock icon has accessible name. aria-bot: Accessibility scan complete — new mock flags contrast issue on the tiny tooltip for the lock icon. Recommend 4.5:1 for small text. Report: https://mock.report/abc123 mike_s (Eng): I'll spin a micro-prototype and drop it in the PR. ETA: EOD Friday. Can someone sign off on copy + A11y before I schedule the work? jamie (Product): I can sign off once we switch badges to icon+color and update the flyout empty-state copy. alyssa: Thanks all — I'll update the mock with those tweaks and post the final PNG. If no objections by Monday I'll ask Eng to implement. :thumbsup:
